notes:
Both full-thesis PDF links returned HTTP 403 and were not retried. Alternative institutional records were abstract-only and linked back to the same thesis repository. Generic abstract sample sizes and narrative claims were not substituted for target-test evidence.
Source follow-up: Complete Spring 2024 master’s thesis, EIU repository 5025. Table 7 rendered PDF p. 69 visually inspected. Table 7 reports paired mean differences, distinct from the Pearson correlations elsewhere. No effect-specific author verdict about replication of this mean-difference test located; no success inferred from p. Table 7 note: “*p < .05 (Bonferroni correction α = .006).” Original side unassigned. Analytic n left null because Table 7 prints neither paired-test n nor df; Table 6 scale sample counts retained as contextual evidence only.
Source follow-up: Primary source is the complete Spring 2020 master’s thesis, repository deposit 4783. Table 6 numeric values were checked against rendered PDF p. 59. Printed d retained without conversion. Exact p column retained; table note gives Bonferroni correction α = .006. Analytic n is contextual from Table 5 scale counts, not independently printed for each Table 6 dependent t-test; n confidence is therefore false. Unassigned replication and original-only success verdict left null.
Completion source review (n_o): Target located by the named BASC Withdrawal/ASCA Avoidant pair in Table 6, matching the description and p. 58 locator. Table 6 reports no separate N; Table 5 explicitly states the analytic sample for the same study scales: 101 except Delinquent, 58. Applied that printed scale-specific N to the paired comparison. No N derived from df, t, p, d, recruitment totals, or numeric matching. No additional exclusions are stated for these scales. Table 5 explicitly identifies 101 for all scales except Delinquent; neither target scale is Delinquent.
